Comfort Click Ltd.note: Zydus Wellness acquired 100% of UK-based Comfort Click Ltd in August 2025 via its subsidiary Alidac UK.

Metagenics, LLC.note: Gryphon Investors acquired a majority stake in Metagenics, Inc. from Alticor Inc. in late 2021.

Nature's Bounty.note: Nestlé acquired the core brands of The Bountiful Company, including Nature's Bounty, in August 2021.

Nutralie.note: French pharmaceutical group URGO acquired an 80% stake in Nutralie (Nutriexperts) in December 2025.

OstroVit Sp. z o.o..note: OstroVit Sp. z o.o. operates as an independent Polish manufacturer of dietary supplements and sport nutrition products.

Puritan's Pride, Inc..note: Nestlé Health Science acquired Puritan's Pride as part of its core brands purchase from The Bountiful Company in 2021.

Smoky Mountain Naturals LLC.note: Smoky Mountain Naturals LLC operates as an independent company trading under its SMNutrition health supplement brand.

Toplux Nutrition.note: Toplux Nutrition is an independent dietary supplement developer and has not raised outside funding or been acquired.

WN Pharmaceuticals Ltd..note: WN Pharmaceuticals Ltd. operates as an independent Canadian-owned company manufacturing vitamins and supplements.
